english.note: Use this colloquially when “untalented” shades into lacking ability or being unimpressive at something.
Use this for someone who is hopelessly unskilled or lacks ability in a particular task.
Use this specifically for a person who lacks the ability or competence to do something.

examples.english: This chef is really untalented; the food they cook is completely substandard.
examples.traditional: 呢個廚師真係冇料，煮出嚟嘅嘢完全冇水準。
